Alan Smith has denied claims that Liverpool fans attacked the ambulance he was in after his serious injury. This happened nine years ago, during Manchester United’s 1-0 loss to Liverpool in the FA Cup.

In February 2006, at Anfield, Smith broke his leg and dislocated his ankle while trying to block a free-kick from John Arne Riise.

At the time, reports said that Liverpool fans tried to stop his trip to the hospital. They allegedly threw bottles, beer glasses, and stones at the ambulance and shook the vehicle.

Ronny Deila has confirmed that Celtic wants to sign Hearts captain Danny Wilson this summer. As reported by Sportsmail, Celtic is thinking about offering £400,000 for the defender, who has previously played for Rangers and Liverpool. Wilson has one year left on his current contract. However, Hearts owner Ann Budge says the club does not need to sell him. Even though Wilson’s contract ends at the end of the season, Hearts are not in a hurry to let him go.

Ronny Deila says Celtic will not risk their chances in the Champions League by playing many difficult games during the pre-season. He blames last summer’s profitable tour of the United States, Austria, and Germany for a bad 4-1 loss to Legia Warsaw in the qualifying round. Celtic makes a lot of money from these pre-season games and has also traveled to Australia and Asia in recent years. Ronny Deila and player Nir Bitton left the field after losing to Legia Warsaw. They have not yet decided whether to go to America again this July.

Franck Ribery has denied rumors that Bayern Munich wants to sign Kevin de Bruyne from Wolfsburg to replace him or his teammate, Arjen Robben.

De Bruyne played mostly on loan at Chelsea for two years before joining the second-place team in the German league, Wolfsburg. This season, he has scored nine goals and leads the league in assists with 16, which is seven more than the next best player.

However, Ribery says that even though De Bruyne is playing well, he is not the right type of player for Bayern’s new coach, Pep Guardiola. Ribery believes De Bruyne has different strengths than he and Robben do.

Kelsi Langley, the girlfriend of an Arizona State University (ASU) football player, has taken back her accusation that he abused her. She says she lied because of her mood swings.

Her boyfriend, Davon Durant, is a talented linebacker who transferred to ASU from a college in Kansas. He was arrested on March 7 for domestic violence after Langley said he hit her in the face and grabbed her neck during an argument in his car.

Because of the arrest, ASU has suspended Durant from the football team indefinitely. He might also be kicked out of the university.

What could be better than meeting your favorite sports star? Imagine meeting them at a Starbucks while wearing a shirt with their name on it, and then having them post a photo of you on their Instagram. A young boy was very lucky to meet Justin Verlander, a pitcher for the Detroit Tigers, in this special way. Verlander took a selfie with the boy, who was wearing a dark blue shirt that had Verlander’s name and jersey number, 35, on the back. You can watch a video of the moment by scrolling down.

Eden Hazard said that playing so many games for Chelsea might have made him too tired to play well. This happened after he was taken out of the game just 62 minutes into Belgium’s win over Israel on Tuesday. Hazard has played 48 games this season for his club and his country, missing only five matches for Chelsea while helping them win the Premier League title. However, during Belgium’s difficult 1-0 victory over Israel in their European Championship qualifying group, manager Marc Wilmots took Hazard off with 28 minutes left because he was having trouble beating his opponent, Orel Dgani.

Police in the Northern Territory found 20 grams of marijuana hidden inside a leg of lamb. The officers noticed a strange smell and decided to X-ray the meat, which showed the bag of drugs inside. They believe the lamb was shipped to a company at Darwin Airport and was supposed to be sent to the Tiwi Islands, located 100 kilometers to the north.

Former footballer Clarke Carlisle says he has separated from his wife, Gemma. They were married for 14 years and lived in Yorkshire. Carlisle is struggling with depression after a suicide attempt in December. This happened two days after he was arrested for suspected drunk driving. He has moved out of the house they shared.

Paul Merson, a famous former player for Arsenal, admitted he was wrong to criticize Andros Townsend’s selection for the England team. Merson had previously written in a Sky Sports article that if Townsend was good enough to make the squad, then anyone could be. However, his opinion changed after Townsend came off the bench and scored a great equalizing goal in England’s 1-1 friendly match against Italy in Turin on Tuesday. After scoring, Townsend celebrated with his Tottenham teammates, Ryan Mason and Kyle Walker.

It is common for Chelsea midfielder Cesc Fabregas to play poorly in the second half of the season. He was one of the worst players in his team’s 2-0 loss to Holland on Tuesday. The 27-year-old said he was happy to live in southwest London earlier this week. However, his performance has dropped significantly. At Christmas, he looked like he would definitely break the record for the most assists in the Barclays Premier League.

West Midlands Police said that six people were arrested in Dover this morning for suspected terrorism related to Syria. The arrests happened around 8 am in the departure area of the port.

Five men and one woman were taken into custody. Four of the men are in their 20s and live in Birmingham, in the West Midlands. The other two people are a 26-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman who do not have a fixed home. All six suspects are currently being questioned at a police station in the West Midlands.

Today, the urge to buy a treat is strongest at 12:52 pm. According to research by VoucherCodes.co.uk, people in Britain spend an average of £62 a week on themselves. This spending often happens at lunchtime. These treats can be small, like a bar of chocolate or a glass of wine, or expensive, like designer clothes and shoes. Surprisingly, men spend one-third more per month than women on these rewards.

Arsene Wenger is highly respected and clearly very smart. Because of this, people often agree with him when he speaks. However, if you look closely at what he says, you might find that his ideas sound good but don’t actually have strong support.

Usually, this happens when he talks about Arsenal’s defense. He often points out that, despite recent bad results, their defensive statistics are actually very good.

Last week, however, he talked about a different issue: rules for player quotas. Specifically, he discussed an idea from Greg Dyke, the head of the English Football Association (FA). Dyke wants to increase the number of homegrown players allowed in a Premier League team’s 25-player squad from eight to 12.

Charlie Austin shared a story about his first day at Queens Park Rangers, when his close friend Joey Barton ignored him. Barton soon realized his mistake, and the two became good friends. Austin has had a memorable first season in the Premier League, scoring 15 goals. Because of this, people think he might soon play for England. Although everyone knows how close Austin and club captain Barton are now, their first meeting was awkward. Austin says he will never forget that early problem between them.

This dog is definitely his owner’s best friend because he saved him from being buried in cold, muddy water. The black dog was filmed bringing a rescue rope to his owner at the Clarence J. Brown Dam and Reservoir in Springfield, Ohio, on Saturday afternoon. The video shows firefighters pulling the man to shore after he had been in water that was about zero degrees Celsius for nearly two hours. He apparently got stuck waist-deep in mud while trying to pick up some duck hunting equipment. Fortunately, he had his cell phone and called 911. However, firefighters could not send a boat to help him because the river was too shallow.

Juventus coach Massimiliano Allegri says he does not think the fans will fully support him until he wins them a championship. He joined the team in Turin last summer, a few months after losing his job at AC Milan. Since then, he has done a great job, leading Juventus to a strong position in the race for the Italian title. He replaced Antonio Conte last summer. On Saturday, Juventus will play Empoli at home, hoping to win three more points. Currently, Juventus is number one in Serie A, and Allegri is directing his team from the sidelines.

Nathan Redmond made a big difference just six minutes after he started playing. Steven Whittaker passed the ball to Redmond along the right side of the field. Redmond ran faster than defender Joe Bennett and sent a low cross into the goal. Bradley Johnson scored with that cross from the back post. This goal won the game for his team in the second half at the Amex Stadium.

For six years, the people of Celoron, New York, have been upset about a statue of their famous hometown resident, Lucille Ball. In 2009, the town opened the statue, but its face looks very different from what people remember. Many locals are shocked and unhappy with how it looks. The statue is not flattering, and a Facebook page titled "We Love Lucy! Get Rid of this Statue" has gained more than 600 likes. Some residents call the statue "monstrous." The statue shows a scene from her TV show "I Love Lucy," where she is drunk and selling a health drink.

Isaac Luke, a player for the South Sydney team, is facing accusations of being homophobic. This happened after he posted an offensive comment on social media. He did this in response to insults from fans of the Canterbury Bulldogs team.

On Saturday, the 27-year-old posted a sincere message on his official Instagram account. He was trying to find a young fan from the South Sydney team (the Rabbitohs). This fan was allegedly attacked at ANZ Stadium in Sydney.

Luke wanted to give the boy a rugby jersey before the Easter holiday weekend. He hoped this gift would help make up for the incident, which left the boy in the hospital after a controversial game.

People who are afraid of spiders should be careful. A man in Wangaratta, in northeast Victoria, had a scary experience when a large huntsman spider came out from inside his car door handle.

The video shows the man walking up to his black Holden Ute. He sprays insect repellent on the door, which forces the spider to show itself from under the handle. The man says, “Get out, you bast***,” in a calm voice. However, when the hairy spider’s legs come out, he yelps and steps back in fear.

Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino has compared Harry Kane to Gabriel Batistuta. Pochettino said he will support Kane when things do not go well.

Kane scored on his full international debut for England. He came on as a substitute against Lithuania at Wembley on Friday night and scored just 79 seconds later. This goal put him within two goals of scoring 30 times in a season.

England manager Roy Hodgson wants to keep expectations for Kane realistic. Kane has risen quickly in his career after finally joining Tottenham’s first team. Before that, he played for other teams on loan, including Leicester and Norwich.

A court has heard that a former footballer, who ran a £30 million investment scheme and lived like a millionaire, is now surviving on handouts. Michael McIndoe, who played for Bristol City and Wolverhampton Wanderers, convinced other footballers to join the plan by promising them a large 20% profit. However, the plan failed because of heavy debts. Last October, McIndoe was declared bankrupt with over £2 million in debts. Known as "Mr Big" in Marbella, where he partied with glamorous women, he is now being pursued by creditors through the courts.

Juventus director Pavel Nedved said that Barcelona wants to sign Paul Pogba. However, Nedved stated that Pogba will not be leaving Juventus. He also mentioned that he was happy because Juventus did not play against Barcelona in the Champions League quarter-finals.

Police say that 48-year-old James Oliver, a convicted sex offender, was seriously injured when his girlfriend, 53-year-old Linda Currier, ran over him with her car. The incident happened on Saturday night in Noblesboro, Maine.

According to police, Currier caught Oliver allegedly trying to sexually assault a 12-year-old girl. After they argued inside the house, Currier allegedly drove her car over Oliver in the driveway. He was left with serious leg injuries.

Liverpool’s manager, Brendan Rodgers, wants to sign Fiorentina goalkeeper Neto, but he faces strong competition. According to Neto’s agent, Stefano Castagna, Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) and several Spanish clubs also want to sign him.

Liverpool was interested in signing the 25-year-old earlier this season after their regular goalkeeper, Simon Mignolet, was removed from the starting lineup. Although a deal in January did not happen, Neto is expected to leave Fiorentina this summer because his contract expires in June. The text also notes that Neto was seen rushing out of his goal to stop Juan Iturbe during a match against Roma in March.

A video posted by YouTube user Richard Stewart shows a Porsche Cayman speeding away from a green light on Prince Edward Island, Canada. The car quickly goes out of control, swerves wildly, and crashes into a concrete median. During the crash, a wheel falls off before the car finally stops. Stewart wrote on YouTube that just because someone has an expensive car does not mean they are a good driver, and he warned people not to let their sons drive their Porsches.

Before this weekend’s Premier League games, Sportsmail will share details for every match, including team updates, possible lineups, betting odds, and statistics from Opta. Here is the information for Sunderland’s home game against Newcastle at the Stadium of Light.

**Team News: Sunderland**

Sunderland midfielder Lee Cattermole will start the game against Newcastle on Sunday. Manager Dick Advocaat confirmed that Cattermole is back after missing two games because he received 10 yellow cards during the season.

If Rory McIlroy wins the upcoming Masters, he will become the first golfer to win every major tournament in his career. This would finish a lifelong dream for the top-ranked player. With his sponsor Bose, McIlroy has released a video showing his journey from playing on small courses as a child to becoming a golf star, including some difficult times. The video starts with McIlroy jogging early in the morning, with the words "Six weeks to Georgia" on the screen. It also includes an interview with McIlroy when he was young, before he became famous.

Sergio Garcia says he is focused on winning his first PGA Tour title since 2012 at this week’s Shell Houston Open, even though the Masters tournament is coming up soon. For weeks, the main topics have been Rory McIlroy’s chance to win his third major in a row and finish his career grand slam, and whether Tiger Woods will return to the game after staying away for a while. Although the Golf Club of Houston is set up to look like the course at Augusta, Garcia is concentrating on ending his long wait for a win. The photo shows Sergio Garcia lining up a putt during the Cadillac Championship in Doral, Florida, last month.

Riki Hughes, a 31-year-old Iraq war veteran, has been sentenced to 16 months in prison. He stole £17,000 from Tidworth Town Football Club, where he volunteered as the club secretary.

Hughes claimed he was using the money to pay rent for the club’s building. However, the team actually used the property for free. Instead of paying rent, Hughes spent the money on himself. This included buying camping gear and paying for a bachelor party trip to Las Vegas. The theft was revealed at Salisbury Crown Court.

Winning is a normal routine for Johnny Sexton. He has made it a habit to win awards every year, and he is determined to keep doing it. As he got ready for a big match against Saracens in Paris on Sunday, the 29-year-old, who plays for Racing Metro and Ireland, thought about his success. He said, “I have been lucky to play for great teams with Leinster and Ireland. There have not been many years when I did not help a team win trophies.” In fact, since he became a senior player in 2010, that is the only year he did not win any major awards.

Mustafa Kamal stepped down as president of the International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday. He said that India influenced the result of the quarter-final match between Bangladesh and India.

Kamal, who is from Bangladesh, made these comments at the airport after returning from the tournament in Australia. He said, "Everyone saw what happened during the Bangladesh-India match... India has influenced the outcome of the match using its position (in the ICC)."

He added, "From now on, I am a former president of the ICC. I would have reacted similarly had it happened to any other country." A photo shows Kamal with the Cricket World Cup trophy.

West Ham manager Sam Allardyce supports Nigel Pearson, the manager of Leicester City, and respects him for being independent. Allardyce worked with Pearson at Newcastle United in 2007, and the two will meet again when West Ham plays Leicester at the King Power Stadium on Saturday. This season, Pearson has been involved in several controversial incidents. These include grabbing Crystal Palace’s James McArthur by the throat and losing his temper with a reporter during a press conference.

Sunderland captain John O'Shea says his team must win their upcoming match against Newcastle to control their own future. The two teams play at the Stadium of Light on Sunday. Sunderland has won the last four games between these rivals, but they really need three points to stay safe in the Barclays Premier League.

If Burnley beats Tottenham in the earlier game, Sunderland could drop into the relegation zone. This makes winning against Newcastle absolutely necessary.

Stoke City manager Mark Hughes is sure his team needs to stop their losing streak against Chelsea. Since being promoted to the Premier League in 2008, Stoke has played Chelsea away eight times in all competitions and lost every single time. The last time Stoke won at Chelsea’s stadium was in 1995, when they won a League Cup match. The last time Stoke got even a single point from a game at Chelsea’s ground was a 1-1 draw in 1984. Mark Hughes says his team must end this long period without winning. In their most recent visit to Stamford Bridge, Chelsea beat Stoke 3-0, with Frank Lampard celebrating the victory.

Newcastle wants to avoid losing three games in a row when they play their rivals, Sunderland, this Sunday. They have been struggling recently because their striker, Papiss Cisse, is banned.

Newcastle is near the bottom of the Premier League, sitting just one point above the teams that will be relegated. However, if it weren’t for Cisse’s goals, Newcastle would actually be two points lower than Sunderland in the relegation zone.

Cisse, who plays for Senegal, is Newcastle’s top scorer this season with 11 goals. Ten of those goals were the deciding factor in winning games for Newcastle.

Dick Advocaat is bringing Lee Cattermole back to the center of his Sunderland team. Cattermole is known as a tough player who controls the game. Advocaat hopes this move will help his team avoid being relegated from the league. He is trying to win his fifth straight derby match against Newcastle.

Cattermole is 27 years old. He missed the last two games because he was suspended. He received 10 yellow cards during the season, which led to the suspension. Because of this, he could not play in Advocaat’s first game as manager. That game was a 1-0 loss to West Ham on March 21.

For Ronny Deila, making it to the Champions League isn’t just about the money. However, there is a strong financial reason for him to lead Celtic to win their fourth title in a row: £16 million. This figure comes from UEFA’s new payment plan for European competitions over the next three years.

When Celtic last played in the Champions League group stage in 2013–14, they played against AC Milan, Ajax, and Barcelona. They won one game and earned £12.6 million. If they achieve the same result (or better) next season, they will earn £4 million more, bringing the total to £16 million. If they advance to the round of 16, the prize money will exceed £20 million.

Tottenham defender Ben Davies will not let his feelings for his Wales teammate, Sam Vokes, affect the game when they play against Burnley on Sunday.

Spurs are going to Burnley’s stadium, Turf Moor, hoping to keep their good form going. They have won three of their last four Premier League games, with only one loss, to Manchester United, before the break for international matches. They are trying to stay in the race for a spot in European competitions.

Burnley is fighting hard to avoid being promoted to the lower division. They are currently in 18th place, but only one point away from safety.

Earlier this season, in the FA Cup, Sam Vokes scored for Burnley against Tottenham. Ben Davies looked upset after Burnley tied the game

Neil Redfearn is thinking about staying on as manager of Leeds United. This comes after the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson, on Thursday. It took the club two months to hire Thompson, but he was told in a letter from director of football Nicola Salerno that he is suspended until the end of the season. This means his time at the club will end after just 105 days. He was also told that his contract will not be renewed when it expires at the end of the season.

John Carver says he will push his Newcastle players hard to make sure they are motivated for Sunday’s big game against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle has lost the last four matches against their local rivals. Carver, who was Alan Pardew’s assistant during those losses, admits that Sunderland wanted to win more than Newcastle did in those games. He said, “In the last four games, Sunderland worked harder than us—and that is not a good statistic to have.” Carver says he will “whip” his players to ensure they are ready to beat Sunderland on Sunday.

David Templeton, who plays for Rangers, said that the previous coaches, Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall, did not train the team well. He said that Stuart McCall, the new manager, has improved the team’s training and tactics. McCall was hired last month for a short time, and he has already helped the team win two games in a row. This has made the players feel more confident as they get ready to play against Hearts this Saturday. Templeton thinks McCall has done a great job since he arrived.

Nolito, a forward for Celta Vigo, says that Lionel Messi should stay home on Sunday instead of playing in their La Liga match. Messi has been training after having a minor foot problem, and he is expected to be ready to play when Barcelona travels to Celta. However, Nolito, who is 28 years old, told the newspaper Marca that he thinks Messi should skip the game. "I guess he will come, but I think he should spend the day at the beach," Nolito said. "I will call his dad in a minute." Despite the injury, Messi is expected to be fit to play against Celta Vigo for Barcelona. He was seen training with his teammate Javier Mascherano on Thursday.

Hearts manager Robbie Neilson says he will only let players like captain Danny Wilson leave if it is good for the club. This week, it was reported that Celtic wants to sign Wilson, who used to play for Rangers. Neilson admitted that other teams showing interest in his young players is normal. However, he agrees with owner Ann Budge that no player will be sold unless Neilson decides it is the right move and the price is right.

Sam Allardyce has warned Brendan Rodgers that giving Raheem Sterling a very large new contract might cause other Liverpool players to ask for more money too. Allardyce believes that if Sterling is paid more than the £100,000 per week he was previously offered, his teammates will demand higher wages. However, Allardyce does not blame Sterling, who currently earns £35,000 a week, for trying to get the best deal possible. Allardyce thinks that because there are so few talented young players, clubs are willing to pay huge amounts of money to sign any good ones they can find. Meanwhile, Raheem Sterling, who plays for both Liverpool and England, has not yet signed a new contract with his club.

Blackpool is talking about signing Thomas Piermayr, a 25-year-old defender from Austria. He has been training with the club this week. Blackpool wants to sign him because they expect to play in League One next season.

Piermayr is currently without a team (a free agent). He used to play for the Colorado Rapids. In 2011, he also played for Inverness Caledonian Thistle. He has never played in England before, but Blackpool could be his first chance to do so.

Tony Pulis plans to speak with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace once the team has secured its place in the Premier League. His goal is to help the club return to being a top-ten team. Pulis believes the club has lost its way in recent years and needs major changes to get back on track. Before last season’s difficult campaign, which ended with a 17th-place finish, the team had finished 10th and 8th under managers Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke. The paragraph also notes that manager Tony Pulis was seen shouting instructions from the sideline during a match against Manchester City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott is leaving north London. Wright thinks Walcott’s difficult time at the club happened because manager Arsene Wenger refused to let him play as a striker. Since returning from a serious knee injury, Walcott has started only five games this season after being out for seven months. With Arsenal trying to sign Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ending next summer, Wright is worried that the team might lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez believes Ross Barkley will become an even more important player for both Everton and England after overcoming his difficult second season at Goodison Park. Barkley has had a mixed year with Everton, partly because he was selected for England’s World Cup team last summer and also because a knee surgery delayed his return to playing. However, England coach Roy Hodgson still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez thinks Barkley’s two recent substitute appearances for England against Lithuania and Italy show that he is ready to improve his performance.

England will not play in the Under-19 European Championships this summer because they lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match. Before this game, England had already beaten Denmark and Azerbaijan. To move on to the finals in Greece in July, they needed to win against France in Saint-Lo. However, goals from Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet gave France the lead. Although Patrick Roberts, who plays for Fulham, scored a late goal for England, it was not enough to help coach Sean O’Driscoll’s team qualify.

Newcastle player Jonas Gutierrez wants to help his team win an important match against Sunderland when he returns to play. The 31-year-old player from Argentina has come off the bench in the last three games since he came back from testicular cancer. His teammates and fans have been very welcoming to him. However, his team has lost all three of those games. He really wants to stop this losing streak. Newcastle is trying to recover from four straight losses, which has never happened before, when they play against their rivals, Sunderland, on Sunday at the Stadium of Light.

After a close game between South Sydney and Canterbury on Good Friday, angry fans threw objects at the referees and officials. The South Sydney team won 18-17 in the last minute at ANZ Stadium in Sydney. However, the win was controversial because the referee, Gerard Sutton, and his team penalized Canterbury’s captain, James Graham, in the final minute. This penalty helped South Sydney secure the victory. As the referees, officials, and players left the field and headed toward the tunnel, some fans threw plastic water bottles and shouted insults at them.

Former England rugby league captain Kevin Sinfield, 34, has been warned that he will be a "target" when he switches to rugby union at the end of the season. Sinfield, who is the greatest captain in Leeds Rhinos' history, surprised the rugby league world on Tuesday by announcing he will leave the sport and join Yorkshire Carnegie, the sister club of Leeds Rhinos, on an 18-month contract.

Raheem Sterling has said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool, even though the club offered him £100,000 a week to stay. The 20-year-old winger is moving closer to leaving Anfield. In a BBC interview on Wednesday, he said that if he had been asked a year ago, he would have signed for much less money.

Even though Sterling is one of Liverpool’s best players, he has not played as well as he did last season. This season, he has scored only six goals—one fewer than Stoke’s Jon Walters. His ability to score goals and the number of minutes he plays per goal have both gotten worse, as shown in the graphic below.

Brighton and Hove Albion, a football team in the Championship league, are the first club to teach its young players about the laws and ethics of sexual consent. According to the BBC, the club is also offering counseling to these players.

The program, called Protect, Inform and Prevent (PIP), teaches players how consent is defined by law. It includes private question-and-answer sessions where players can discuss past experiences. The sessions are led by a former police detective and a psychotherapist.

A new video shows homeless people reading cruel tweets written about them. This clip was made by the agency Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans. The goal is to make people think more carefully about how they treat homeless individuals. Many of the people in the video cry while reading hurtful comments, such as "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you" and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited."

George Boyd is the hardest-working player in the Barclays Premier League this season. He has run a total of 210.5 miles on the field. This distance is equal to running from Burnley’s stadium, Turf Moor, to Crystal Palace’s stadium, Selhurst Park, in south London. Boyd has run slightly farther than Christian Eriksen, a midfielder for Tottenham Hotspur. According to Google Maps, walking from Turf Moor to Selhurst Park would normally take 69 hours. However, Boyd has covered this distance in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police in Birmingham have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby who died. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, live in Perry Barr. They were taken into custody after their daughter died yesterday afternoon.

Police were called to the family’s home just before 1:00 am yesterday because the baby was having trouble breathing. The baby was taken to Birmingham Children's Hospital but died a few hours later.

A police spokesperson said the death is being treated as suspicious. A post-mortem exam will happen today to find out exactly how the baby died.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by pausing talks about a new contract until the summer. The 20-year-old English player was offered what manager Brendan Rodgers called "an incredible offer," which is believed to be £100,000 a week, but the negotiations have stalled. Sterling has said he is not just interested in money, and Taylor thinks it is smart to wait until the season ends before continuing the discussions. In a TV interview, Sterling admitted he is not ready to sign a new deal with Liverpool yet.

Things have been difficult for former Manchester United player Anderson since he returned to Brazil. However, on Wednesday, his mistake was less important than a teammate’s foolish behavior.

Anderson was sent off from his team, Internacional, after shoving an opposing player, Otacilio Neto, during the first half. The opposing player was also sent off for hitting back with an elbow.

But Anderson’s teammate, Fabricio, drew more attention. Fabricio swore at his own fans and became the third player to be sent off. This left Internacional with only nine players in a game that ended in a 1-1 tie in Porto Alegre.

A seven-year-old boy was raped and set on fire by two young men while he was out buying food. According to Inspector Sasthe, the attackers took the boy to a secluded spot. When he fought back, they set him ablaze. The boy, who now has burns covering 30 percent of his body, managed to escape. The crime took place in Padma Nagar, Bhiwandi, which is a suburb of Mumbai. Police are currently investigating the case.

Dug, a pug, has fully recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. On Thursday, Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, Canada. They heard a rattling noise. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the sound. The snake bit Dug in the face, causing his face to swell to twice its normal size immediately.

Real Madrid defender Alvaro Arbeloa says that Jose Mourinho might manage Real Madrid again in the future, even though he left the club in a difficult way. Mourinho managed Real Madrid for three years before returning to Chelsea in 2013. When he left, there were rumors that he had arguments with top players, including captain Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. However, Arbeloa, who has played 25 times for the team this season, believes that Real Madrid will always be open to hiring the Portuguese coach back as their manager.

On Saturday, Liverpool and their manager, Brendan Rodgers, reached the end of their efforts at the Emirates Stadium. Their hopes of qualifying for the Champions League are now gone. During a 15-minute press conference, Rodgers admitted that his team would not make it into the tournament. This moment marked the end of missed chances.

Rodgers tried to stay positive. He is not the type of manager to look sad or defeated, but he did not pretend that this has been an easy season. Last year, Liverpool fought hard for the title, but this year they have fallen out of the race. It is a harsh reality for a club that thought it was close to winning again. Even so, it still feels like Liverpool are moving forward under Rodgers’ leadership.

Inter Milan’s coach, Roberto Mancini, was very angry after his team tied 1-1 with Parma, a team that is last in the league. Because of this result, Inter stayed in ninth place, tied with Genoa and 10 points away from qualifying for European competitions.

To punish the players’ poor attitude, Mancini cancelled their day off on Easter Sunday. He ordered them to come to an early morning training session at 8:30 a.m. Inter Milan confirmed on their website that the first team trained that morning. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio were there to watch.

Many fans want to buy rare items that belonged to their favorite players or teams, and small pieces of history can sell for thousands of pounds. However, an expired passport of Paul Parker, a well-known defender for Manchester United and England in the 1990s, was listed on eBay for £5,000. The listing started in early March, and bidding ended on Tuesday, but it is not clear if anyone actually paid that amount.

A builder named Paddy Morrall saw an image of Jesus on a piece of wood in Inverness, Scotland, on Wednesday. This happened just a few days before Easter.

Paddy, who is 31 years old and from Keighley near Bradford, works as a builder. He and his coworkers left a broken scaffolding board outside in the rain for several hours. When they came back, they saw a full-length image of Jesus wearing a robe on the wood.

People have seen similar images on toast, pancakes, crisps, and even ice cream. But Paddy was surprised to see it on a piece of wood. He has kept the board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly match. This game was between two countries that used to be part of Czechoslovakia.

Ondrej Duda, a 20-year-old midfielder, scored the only goal after the break. He made his second international goal by taking a low shot from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute.

This win was Slovakia’s third victory in 10 matches against the Czech Republic since the two countries split in 1993. The Czech Republic has won five of those games.

During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel hit Czech player Daniel Kolar in the face with a high kick. Slovakia celebrated their win, which continues their strong recent performance.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed he can do more than just play football. He posted a video of himself rapping while driving his Bugatti Veyron. This happened as Real Madrid gets ready to play against Granada at the Bernabeu stadium on Sunday. In the video, Benzema sings along to the song "Check Out Time" by Tupac. The video shows the French forward singing along to Tupac in his car.

A wealthy businessman who supports UKIP and helped force Liam Fox to quit as Defence Secretary is now trying to stop a popular Conservative candidate from winning. Harvey Boulter has already given £30,000 to the UKIP candidate running against Fox in Somerset, as part of his ongoing anger toward Fox. Boulter is also spending another £30,000 to try to defeat Tom Tugendhat, who is running for the Conservatives in Tonbridge and West Malling, Kent.

Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield tied 1-1 in their match. Two goals were scored in the final four minutes of the game. Sergiu Bus, a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored first in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute, scored for Huddersfield just before the end to make it 1-1. The text also notes that Sergiu Bus celebrated after scoring for Sheffield Wednesday.

Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton signed him three years ago. At the time, Dallas was playing part-time for Crusaders, a local team, for just £70 a week.

Now 23, Dallas recently played well for Northern Ireland. He also scored two great goals when Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. Because of this win, Brentford is now aiming for promotion to the Premier League, not just a spot in the play-offs. They will play Nottingham Forest on Monday. Dallas has been a surprise success this season as he helps Brentford move closer to the top flight.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it makes sense that people feel strongly about their favorite professional teams. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals and the two most popular teams. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves also have many fans, especially in the South. However, some teams, like the New York Mets, have fewer fans. Scroll down for the video.

Trey Moses, a basketball star and senior at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky, made many people happy with a kind gesture. He asked Ellie Meredith, a girl with Down syndrome, to be his date for prom.

Moses, who will play basketball for Ball State next year, volunteers with teens who have learning disabilities. He surprised Ellie during her physical education class with flowers and a sign that said, "Let's Party Like it's 1989." This was a reference to a Taylor Swift album, since Swift is Ellie’s favorite singer.

Ellie said yes and is excited to go dress shopping. She told CNN that she has already told "a million people" about the news.

On April Fools’ Day, President Barack Obama made a joke by pretending to be Frank Underwood, a character from the TV show *House of Cards*. Frank Underwood is a tricky politician played by actor Kevin Spacey, who often talks directly to the audience in a fancy, old-fashioned way.

In the video, President Obama turned his head and said, “Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood. This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools’ Day. Frank learned it from me.” He also used a Southern accent to sound more like the character.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday with a suspected heart problem. He was playing against Fenerbahce when he had to leave the game after just 30 minutes. After being removed from the match, he went for medical tests. The team said on social media that he is not in immediate danger based on the initial results.

Obraniak is from Poland and is currently on loan at Caykur Rizespor from the German club Werder Bremen. Meanwhile, Fenerbahce won the match 5-1, with Moussa Sow scoring a goal and celebrating.

Three people were taken to the hospital as a precaution after a crash on Easter Sunday night in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney. The accident happened at a traffic light on Warringah Road when a 1973 E-Type Jaguar hit a Toyota Kluger head-on. The vintage Jaguar, which is believed to be worth more than $120,000, was completely destroyed. Although no one was injured, all three adults in the cars were taken to the hospital. NSW police are still investigating how the crash happened.

People in Lijin village, Dongying city, in Shandong Province, eastern China, are carrying natural gas in large plastic bags. Recent photos show residents using rickshaws to move bags that can be up to six meters long. The People’s Daily Online reported this practice.

Passers-by are worried because natural gas is explosive. They compared the scene to carrying a bomb, noting that even a small spark from a match or a cigarette could cause a disaster.

Local media say this method is common in some villages in Shandong. They believe it is a way for villagers to save money on transportation costs.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which has raised hopes that he will play in this year’s Masters. This is the first Major tournament of the year. Woods has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5, when he withdrew from the Farmers Insurance Open because his back pain came back. Since then, he has taken time off to try to get back to his best form. Many people think he might return for the Masters, a tournament he has won four times. He was spotted practicing at Augusta on Tuesday, and reports say he has gone back to playing on the course. Woods has also fallen out of the top 100 in the world rankings for the first time in nearly 19 years.

The BBC is facing criticism for spending thousands of pounds of public money on a 44-page guide that teaches staff how to use emojis correctly. BBC executives hired an agency to research how to use smiley faces in news stories and on social media. They also paid designers to create graphics of popular stars, like Gary Lineker and Graham Norton, as emojis. This spending happened before the BBC used a "sad face" emoji to report the death of the world’s oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top long-distance runner and frequent training partner of Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. This is because he reported to the police in his home country, Uganda, that a coach was sexually abusing female runners, some as young as 15.

Kipsiro won the 10,000-meter race at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last year. He told Sportsmail that five female runners came to him for help. After he reported these claims to the police and his national sports federation, he received death threats.

Patrick Kluivert, a former player and assistant coach for the Netherlands, has started well as the coach of Curacao’s national team. On Tuesday night, Curacao moved on to the next round of World Cup qualifying for 2018 in the CONCACAF region. They drew 2-2 in their second match against Montserrat, which gave them a total score of 4-3. This followed a 2-1 win on Saturday in Willemstad. Kluivert, who previously worked with Louis van Gaal at the 2014 World Cup, has helped Curacao reach this stage of the competition.

An 18-year-old student named Brady Eaves was caught on video biting the head off a live hamster. As a result, he has been kicked out of his fraternity, removed from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation.

DailyMail.com reported last weekend that Eaves, who was privately educated and is the stepson of a former candidate for governor in Mississippi, was seen laughing while killing the small animal. The video was recorded at a drunken Spring Break party in Florida.

Because of this footage, Eaves could face serious legal charges for animal cruelty. If convicted, he could spend up to five years in jail and be fined $5,000.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, said on Wednesday that Kumar Sangakkara should change his mind about retiring from limited-overs cricket and play for one more year. Sangakkara announced he was leaving one-day cricket on March 18. He was upset after his team lost in the World Cup quarter-finals. He also said he was happy because Sri Lanka is in a better position now than when he joined the team in 2000. Dissanayake made this request after naming a new temporary group to run the sport, led by former test cricketer Sidath Wettimuny.

Head coach Alan Solomons has called them back for the match at Madejski Stadium. He plans to pick his strongest team for this important game.

Ramsey’s team, QPR, plays against Pulis’s West Brom this Saturday at The Hawthorns. QPR is currently 19th in the Premier League, four points behind 17th-place Sunderland. They hope for a strong finish like the one Pulis led with Crystal Palace in 2013-14, when his team won 17 points in their last eight games to avoid being relegated. Ramsey praised Pulis before this important match.

An 18-year-old student named Silhan Ozcelik appeared in court. She is accused of planning to travel abroad to join Kurdish rebels fighting against the Islamic State.

Ozcelik, who is Kurdish, went missing from her family’s home in north London last October when she was still 17. The court heard that she traveled on the Eurostar train with another man to Stuttgart, Germany. This is where the youth group of the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) has its headquarters.

She is accused of preparing to carry out a terrorist attack in October 2014.

Esteban Cambiasso, a midfielder for Leicester City, knows how it feels to win major football trophies. However, he says that keeping his team from being relegated (forced to leave the league) would be one of the best moments of his career.

Cambiasso used to play for Inter Milan in Italy, where he won five league titles and the Champions League in 2010. He also played for the Argentina national team.

He told the BBC that avoiding relegation feels like winning another cup. He joined Leicester last summer for free and signed a one-year contract.

Crystal Palace manager Alan Pardew says Manchester City can still win the Premier League title, even if they are behind Chelsea. He points out that City has done this before. Last season, they passed Liverpool with only one game left to play. In 2012, Sergio Aguero scored a goal in the last minute of the final match, which allowed City to win the title instead of Manchester United.

Right now, Chelsea is six points ahead of the other teams and has one extra game they have not played yet. However, Pardew does not think the race is finished. His team, Crystal Palace, plays against Manchester City on Monday. Pardew has made it clear that he does not believe City is out of the running for the championship.

Hull City has asked the Football Association (FA) again to change the club’s name to Hull Tigers. This happened after their first request was rejected. Many fans were angry because they thought they had won the fight to keep the name Hull City when the FA council voted 47 to 27 against the change. Ulster has announced that it is signing New Zealand rugby player Charles Piutau. Piutau, who is 23 years old, can play as a full back, wing, or center. He has signed a two-year contract that starts in July 2016.

Piutau has played for the New Zealand national team, the All Blacks, since making his debut against France two years ago. He has earned 14 caps for his country. He has also played for the Blues in New Zealand since 2012.

Ulster team manager Bryn Cunningham said that signing someone with Piutau’s skills is very exciting for the team.

Fiorentina beat Sampdoria 2-0 in the rain. This win moved Fiorentina to fourth place with 49 points. Alessandro Diamanti, who used to play for West Ham, scored just after the 60th minute. Then, Mohamed Salah, who is playing for Fiorentina on loan from Chelsea, scored two minutes later.

Mohamed Salah kept scoring, as he had done in the first game. The text also notes that Salah turned away after scoring Fiorentina’s second goal in their win over Sampdoria.

Juventus won 2-0 against Empoli on Saturday. This victory keeps them on track to win their fourth straight Serie A title. Carlos Tevez scored the first goal just before halftime, and Roberto Pereyra scored the second goal in the final moments of the game. With nine games left in the season, Juventus leads the league by 14 points. They have now secured a strong chance to win the title.

Kevin de Bruyne’s agent says there is no agreement for the player to leave Wolfsburg this summer, even though he admitted that several clubs are watching him. De Bruyne has become one of the most sought-after players in European football after his strong performances in the Bundesliga, with reports linking him to Manchester City and Bayern Munich. His agent, Patrick De Koster, told FOCUS Online that while many teams are interested and have had informal talks, no transfer deal has been made.

Swansea manager Garry Monk wants to win his first game of the season when they play Hull on Saturday. This match comes after a break for international games.

Swansea has had a great season so far. They have been in the top ten teams for the whole time and are currently in eighth place. They are close to getting the most points they have ever had in the Premier League.

Swansea has eight games left to play. They need five more points to beat the 47 points they got in their first season in the Premier League (2011-12).

Ronaldo, who won the 2002 World Cup, co-owns the Fort Lauderdale Strikers, a second-division team in the United States. He wants to do everything possible to make his club a major global force. The former Barcelona and Real Madrid player said he wants the best talent in the world to join his team. In fact, Ronaldo stated he would pay out of his own pocket to sign Lionel Messi to his US team. Additionally, the Fort Lauderdale Strikers are also trying to sign Cristiano Ronaldo.

Northampton has confirmed that George North will miss Saturday’s European Champions Cup quarter-final match against Clermont Auvergne because of his latest head injury. The team will wait for advice from medical experts before deciding when he can play again.

North has been knocked unconscious three times in recent months, including during last Friday’s 52-30 victory over Wasps. On Wednesday, he was examined by a neurologist.

Saints director of rugby Jim Mallinder said, “We won’t play him at the weekend.” He explained that North had a serious hit and was unconscious for a short time.

Cesar Azpilicueta believes Chelsea will win the Barclays Premier League title. He says the team has shown its strength by staying at the top of the league since the beginning. The Spanish defender and his teammates are currently in first place. They are about to play Stoke City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday. They are six points ahead of their closest rivals, Manchester City, and have one more game played than City. People have long thought Chelsea were likely to win the title. Azpilicueta says this is because the team started very well in August. They won seven of their first eight games, which put them in first place early on.

Mohamed Diame will return to play for Hull City when they visit Swansea on Saturday. Hull manager Steve Bruce confirmed that Diame, a midfielder from Senegal, will take part in the game at some point. Diame joined Hull from West Ham for £3.5 million in the summer but has been injured with a knee problem for over four months. Bruce said Diame is physically strong and doing well, despite the long break. His return helps Hull as they fight to avoid being relegated from the league.

Toby Alderweireld will go back to Atletico Madrid when his one-year loan at Southampton ends. This was confirmed by Atletico’s sporting director, Jose Luis Perez Caminero. The 26-year-old Belgian defender has done well this season. He has previously said he would like to stay in the Premier League permanently, and Tottenham is also interested in him. However, Atletico plans for him to return to Spain. The club also expects another player, Oliver Torres, to come back from his loan at Porto in Portugal.

Tom Carroll, a player for Swansea who is on loan from Tottenham, will be out of action for up to six weeks because of ankle ligament damage. He got injured while playing for England’s Under-21 team in their 1-0 win over the Czech Republic last Friday. Carroll scored the only goal of the match, which took place in Prague. After scoring the winning goal, his teammates celebrated with him. So far this season, he has made 18 appearances for Swansea during his one-year loan from Tottenham.

Franck Ribery says he will not be able to play for Bayern Munich against Borussia Dortmund this week because he has not recovered from his injury. He admitted that he is in such bad shape that he cannot even run.

Ribery got hurt at the start of last month during a game against Shakhtar Donetsk. He had to leave the field walking because of the pain. In that same game, his teammate Arjen Robben also got injured.

Despite this, Ribery hopes he can return to play in the German Cup quarter-final match against Bayer Leverkusen in the middle of the week.

The text also notes two other moments: Ribery celebrating a Champions League goal against Shakhtar Donetsk, and being tackled by a defender named Benjamin Kessel while playing for Bayern Munich against Braunschweig.

Bayern Munich captain Philipp Lahm could make his first Bundesliga start since returning from an ankle injury when he plays against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday. Lahm has fully recovered from his broken ankle. However, coach Pep Guardiola said on Friday that several other players are unavailable. Midfielders Franck Ribery (ankle), Arjen Robben (stomach), and Javi Martinez (knee), as well as defender David Alaba (knee), are all out. Guardiola was not yet sure if defender Holger Badstuber (hip) would play. He also said that midfielder Thiago Alcantara might play for "a few minutes" as he recovers from long-standing knee injuries.

Burnley defender Michael Duff thinks his manager, Sean Dyche, could one day manage the England national team. Dyche, who is 43 years old, has built a strong reputation since he started at Burnley in October 2012. When he arrived, many people thought Burnley would lose their place in the top league. Instead, Dyche helped the team improve greatly and win promotion to the Premier League last season. Duff, a long-time player for Burnley, is getting ready to play against Tottenham on Sunday. He supports his manager’s chance to lead England in the future.

Mauricio Pochettino has agreed to let Harry Kane play in the European Under-21 Championships this summer. Roy Hodgson confirmed that the Tottenham striker will be part of Gareth Southgate’s team for the tournament in the Czech Republic. This is happening even though Kane made his first appearance for the senior England team last week.

Kane will also travel to Australia and Malaysia before the championships begin. He recently played for England against Italy, starting the game after coming off the bench. He had previously scored in a match against Lithuania.

Alvaro Morata’s agent, Beppe Bozzo, says that Morata wants to keep improving at Juventus and does not want to go back to Real Madrid. The 22-year-old moved to Juventus last summer for £15.8 million. He had not been playing regularly for Real Madrid’s first team. At Juventus, he signed a five-year contract. Before moving, he had started only three games for Real Madrid in the 2013-14 season. Morata is happy at Juventus. Since moving to Turin, he has done well, scoring seven goals in 22 Serie A games this season.

Hundreds of thousands of football fans are having a hard time traveling this weekend because train services are shut down for repairs during Easter. More than half of these games will face delays and disruptions, forcing fans to drive instead. The big match between Arsenal and Liverpool in London will also be affected by these train problems. The Labour Party says the Government failed to learn from the travel chaos on Boxing Day, when nearly a million fans had terrible journeys to see their teams.

The letter was dated Tuesday and made public on Wednesday, and the senators strongly urged FIFA to move the tournament to a different country.

Juan Arango, the captain of the Mexican soccer team Tijuana, has apologized to an opposing player after biting him. The incident happened at the end of a difficult match between Tijuana and Monterrey. With only seconds left in the game, Tijuana was losing 4-3. Arango approached Monterrey’s midfielder, Jesus Zavala, and bit him on the shoulder.

Arango, who is 34 years old, admitted, "I did something I shouldn't have done with Zavala." The bite occurred in a moment of anger. Zavala’s team went on to win the game 4-3. After being bitten, Zavala showed the referee the mark on his shoulder.

Reports that Cristiano Ronaldo is getting worse are wrong. Playing for Real Madrid, he scored five goals against Granada. This brings his total for the season to 36 goals in La Liga. This is more than half of the top teams in Europe.

Most ads in newsagent windows are practical, like those for kittens for sale or handymen for hire. However, one man, known only as John, used a window ad as an alternative to internet dating. John, who is reportedly a builder, wrote his ad in capital letters with black pen and posted it in the window of a newsagent in Muswell Hill. He listed his requirements and offered "a way of life with quality." A passerby saw the ad, took a photo, and put it online, causing it to go viral.

During the opening match of the Allsvenskan season, Helsingborg’s manager, Henrik Larsson, had to put 42-year-old kit man Daniel Andersson in goal. This was because the team’s regular goalkeepers, Par Hansson and Matt Pyzdrowski, were injured.

Andersson, a former striker who played for Celtic and Barcelona, kept a clean sheet, helping Helsingborg draw 0-0 against Kalmar.

After the game, Andersson told local TV, “It was a situation I never could have prepared for. I went from being a kit man, to a goalie coach, to actually playing.”

Andersson is a retired goalkeeper who played one match for the Swedish national team in 2001.

Ben Jones-Bishop scored an amazing solo try to help the Salford Red Devils win 24-18. This victory ended a long losing streak for Salford, as they had not beaten Wigan in 17 games. The match was exciting, and both teams ended with only 12 players on the field because tempers flared.

Jones-Bishop, who joined Salford from Leeds Rhinos recently, now has seven tries this season, making him the team’s top scorer. His try came at the 60-minute mark, helping Salford move up to third place in the league standings, passing Wigan. At halftime, Salford was leading 12-8.

On Monday, at Selhurst Park, Pardew—who now manages Crystal Palace—will face Pellegrini and his team, Manchester City, for the second time. This time, Pardew has taken steps to fix a bad habit that he worried was becoming harmful. He followed advice from the League Managers’ Association and worked with Jeremy Snape, a former cricketer who is now a sports psychologist. These sessions have helped the 53-year-old Pardew improve his behavior.

Former rugby star Mils Muliaina, who won the World Cup, has been released on bail after being arrested for suspected sexual assault. The 34-year-old, who played 100 games for the New Zealand national team (the All Blacks), denies the charges.

Police arrested him last night at Kingsholm Stadium after his team, Connacht, lost 14-7 to Gloucester in the quarter-finals of the European Challenge Cup. Muliaina had been injured during the game when officers approached him. He was taken away in connection with an incident that took place in Cardiff in March.

Even without Tiger Woods or Rory McIlroy, the Shell Houston Open in Humble, Texas, is doing very well. Record crowds have come to see the event, which is the final tournament before the Masters. The show is being driven by the popularity of Phil Mickelson and local favorite Jordan Spieth.

Eighteen months ago, people criticized Spieth, then 21, for quitting college to join the PGA Tour when he was ranked only 809th in the world. Since then, he has risen to number four in the world rankings. Today, no one is criticizing him.
